package demo;
import javax.baja.job.*;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public class BExportJob
  extends BSimpleJob
{
  public BExportJob() {}
  @Override
  public void run(Context cx) throws Exception
  {
    for (int i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
      progress(i);
    }
  }
  private String[] names = new String[0];
}
